reviews.text: Project exceeded timeline by ~2 months. Labor presence was inconsistent. Second floor was installed uneven and had to be reworked after repeated requests. Fireplace stone work shows poor craftsmanship. Within one year, kitchen components are failing (doors, paint). I am now paying to re-remodel significant portions of the home. I do not recommend this company

We are midway through a home addition project with Elevate and so far I only have great things to say. We have Rodrigo on a tight timeline as I’m due for a baby in early November and we appear to be on schedule. It is clear they have a reliable team of long standing contractors. I will update once our project is finalized if anything changes but so far our project seems to be progressing really well and we are excited to see the final result!
